description: Honest parameter-free test of whether the Whipple toroidal amplitude at the physical forced windings (mu,nu)=(1/2,d-1/2) reproduces the observed even/odd binding ratio (deuteron, d=2). No fit; explicit NULL if no parameter-free match. auditOnly.

results.note: Only the deuteron (d=2, single pn bond) has a clean axial distance; heavier isotopes lack a single d and are reported unscored.

verdict: NULL (honest, not a fit): the bare Whipple constant |C(nu,mu)| and the raw toroidal amplitude ratio at the physical forced windings (mu,nu)=(1/2,d-1/2) do NOT reproduce the observed even/odd binding ratio (deuteron B_even/B_odd) to 5% under any parameter-free combination {C, 1/C, amp, 1/amp}. The Whipple identification is mathematically exact but its BARE amplitude is not the observable ratio -- the binding-closure gap must supply the E0-scaled, many-body dressing between the dimensionless toroidal amplitude and the MeV even/odd split. This sharpens (does not close) the gap; nothing is fitted or wired.
